name: web3-tools-mcp

tools.name: get_function_signature
tools.description: Generate 4-byte function selectors from ABI definitions. BATCH OPTIMIZED - use for transaction decoding.

functionAbi.description: Function ABI definition (e.g., "function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)")

items.description: Array of function ABI definitions. Batch multiple functions for efficiency.

tools.name: get_event_signature
tools.description: Generate event topic0 hashes from ABI definitions. BATCH OPTIMIZED - use for log filtering setup.

eventAbi.description: Event ABI definition (e.g., "event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)")

items.description: Array of event ABI definitions. Batch multiple events for optimal performance.

tools.name: get_error_signature
tools.description: Generate 4-byte error selectors from ABI definitions. BATCH OPTIMIZED - use for revert reason decoding.

errorAbi.description: Error ABI definition (e.g., "error InsufficientBalance(uint256 available, uint256 required)")

items.description: Array of error ABI definitions. Batch related errors for efficiency.

tools.name: encode_function_data
tools.description: Encode a function call with parameters into transaction data. Use this before calling write_contract.

functionAbi.description: Function ABI definition (e.g., "function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)")

args.description: Function arguments in order matching the ABI signature. Automatically type-converted.

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Read state from contracts by calling view/pure functions. Nothing is sent on-chain and no wallet is involved. BATCH OPTIMIZED - use for reading contract state, token metadata.

chain.description: Blockchain network (mainnet, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, celo, localhost)

contractAddress.description: Contract address to call (must be valid checksummed address)

functionAbi.description: Function ABI signature string (e.g., "function balanceOf(address owner) view returns (uint256)"). Only view/pure functions allowed.

args.description: Function arguments in order matching the ABI signature. Automatically type-converted.

blockNumber.description: Block number for historical queries (defaults to latest)

label.description: Optional label to identify this call in batch results

calls.description: Array of contract function calls. Automatically batched by chain/block for optimal performance.

tools.name: is_contract
tools.description: Determine if address is smart contract or EOA. Returns contract status and bytecode length.

address.description: Address to check (returns true if contract, false if EOA/wallet)

tools.name: get_contract_abi
tools.description: Retrieve contract ABI, proxy info, and verification status from Etherscan. Use for contract analysis.

address.description: The contract address to get ABI for

include.description: Optional: specify which data to include. Options: "abi" (contract ABI), "implementationAbi" (proxy implementation ABI), "metadata" (name, verification), "compilation" (compiler, optimization), "creation" (creator, tx), "stats" (function/event counts). Defaults to ["abi", "metadata"] for minimal context usage.

tools.name: get_contract_source_code
tools.description: Retrieve verified contract source code from Etherscan. PROXY AWARE - automatically fetches implementation source for proxies.

address.description: The contract address to get source code for

includeImplementation.description: For proxy contracts, also fetch implementation source code (default: true)

includeSource.description: Source code inclusion level: "full" (complete source), "summary" (file list with stats only), "none" (metadata only). Default: summary

tools.name: get_contract_source_file
tools.description: Retrieve a specific source file from a cached contract. Use get_contract_source_code first to cache the contract.

filePath.description: Specific file path to retrieve. If omitted, returns list of available files.

useImplementation.description: For proxy contracts, get file from implementation instead (default: false)

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Retrieve native and ERC20 token balances for multiple addresses. BATCH OPTIMIZED - use for portfolio tracking, wallet monitoring.

address.description: The address to check balance for

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address (optional, if not provided returns native token balance)

blockNumber.description: Block number to query (optional, defaults to latest)

queries.description: Array of balance queries. Omit tokenAddress for native balance, include for ERC20.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Search and decode contract events with filtering. Uses viem with hypersync fallback. Specify address and block ranges for best performance. Returns at most 1000 logs; past that, truncated is true and nextBlock says where to resume.

eventAbi.description: Event ABI definition (e.g., "event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)")

fromBlock.description: Start block (defaults to the latest block)

toBlock.description: End block, inclusive (defaults to the latest block)

eventArgs.description: Filter by indexed parameters: {"from": "0x123...", "to": "0x456..."}. A list matches any of its values: {"to": ["0x1...", "0x2..."]}

tools.name: get_storage_at
tools.description: ⚠️ ADVANCED: Direct storage slot access with type decoding. Use for low-level contract inspection.

tools.name: get_block_info
tools.description: Retrieve block data including timestamps, hashes, and dates. Use for time-based analysis.

tools.name: trace_transaction
tools.description: ⚠️ INTENSIVE: Detailed transaction analysis including call traces and state changes. Use sparingly.

traceType.description: Trace type: "trace" (call tree, recommended), "prestate" (state of every touched account before the tx), "stateDiff" (state before and after, changed fields only)

useAnvil.description: Force tracing through the debug node (ANVIL_RPC_URL). Used automatically as a fallback when the RPC cannot trace.

summarize.description: Return a compact summary instead of the full trace: the path to the revert, or the top-level calls, with selectors only and no calldata.

tools.name: debug_call
tools.description: Simulate a contract call with full trace output. Needs a node exposing debug_traceCall (a local Anvil, or ANVIL_RPC_URL). Useful for debugging reverts and understanding call execution.

data.description: Calldata (hex encoded). Either provide this or functionAbi + args.

functionAbi.description: Function ABI signature (e.g., "function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)"). Use with args parameter.

blockNumber.description: Block number to fork from (defaults to latest)

traceType.description: Trace type: callTracer (call tree) or prestateTracer (state before execution)

summarize.description: Return a compact summary instead of the full trace: the path to the revert, or the top-level calls, with selectors only and no calldata.

tools.name: resolve_ens_name
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name to its Ethereum address. ENS names are human-readable identifiers (like vitalik.eth) that resolve to Ethereum addresses.

chain.description: Where the name lives: mainnet for .eth (ENS), linea for Linea Names, base for Basenames. Defaults to mainnet.

name.description: ENS name to resolve to an address (e.g., 'vitalik.eth', 'example.eth')

tools.name: reverse_resolve_ens
tools.description: Reverse resolve an Ethereum address to its primary ENS name. Returns the ENS name if the address has set a reverse record.

chain.description: Where the name lives: mainnet for .eth (ENS), linea for Linea Names, base for Basenames. Defaults to mainnet.

address.description: Ethereum address to resolve to an ENS name

tools.name: get_ens_text_record
tools.description: Retrieve a text record from an ENS name. Common keys include 'avatar', 'description', 'email', 'url', 'com.twitter', 'com.github'.

chain.description: Where the name lives: mainnet for .eth (ENS), linea for Linea Names, base for Basenames. Defaults to mainnet.

name.description: ENS name to query text records from

tools.name: get_ens_avatar
tools.description: Get the raw avatar text record for an ENS name: an https/ipfs URL, a data URI, or an NFT reference (eip155:1/erc721:0x…/1). It is not fetched or resolved to an image.

chain.description: Where the name lives: mainnet for .eth (ENS), linea for Linea Names, base for Basenames. Defaults to mainnet.

name.description: ENS name to get avatar from

tools.name: batch_resolve_ens_names
tools.description: Resolve multiple ENS names to addresses in a single batch for efficiency.

chain.description: Where the name lives: mainnet for .eth (ENS), linea for Linea Names, base for Basenames. Defaults to mainnet.

names.description: Array of ENS names to resolve to addresses in a single batch

tools.name: simulate_contract
tools.description: Simulate a contract call (including state-changing functions) without broadcasting. Returns simulation result and estimated gas.

functionAbi.description: Function ABI signature (e.g., "function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)"). Can be any function type.

args.description: Function arguments in order matching the ABI signature

value.description: ETH value to send with the transaction (in wei as string)

blockNumber.description: Block number for simulation (defaults to latest)

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate gas required for a transaction. Supports contract calls, transfers, and deployments.

value.description: ETH value to send (in wei as string)

data.description: Transaction data (hex string for contract calls or deployment bytecode)

functionAbi.description: Optional: Function ABI signature to encode call data automatically

args.description: Optional: Function arguments (only used with functionAbi)

tools.name: get_gas_price
tools.description: Get current gas prices for a chain. Returns both legacy gasPrice and EIP-1559 fees (maxFeePerGas, maxPriorityFeePerGas).

formatted.description: Return prices in Gwei (default: true). If false, returns wei.

tools.name: get_token_prices
tools.description: USD prices from DefiLlama for tokens on one chain, now or at a past timestamp. Use the zero address for the chain's native token. Tokens DefiLlama cannot price are listed as unpriced — usually spam or illiquid.

tokens.description: Token contract addresses (up to 25); 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 for the native token

timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds for a past price (defaults to now)

tools.name: get_yield_pools
tools.description: DeFi lending, staking and liquidity pools from DefiLlama, highest APY first — e.g. where USDC earns most on Arbitrum, or what Aave pays on Base. Pools DefiLlama flags as APY outliers are left out. APY is a percentage.

chain.description: Only pools on this chain (defaults to every chain this server supports)

symbol.description: Only pools holding this token, e.g. "USDC" (matches "USDC" and "USDC-WETH")

project.description: Only this protocol, as DefiLlama names it — "aave" matches aave-v3 and aave-v2

minTvlUsd.description: Leave out pools smaller than this, in USD (default 1M)

tools.name: check_signing_request
tools.description: Collect the result of a signing request that was still waiting for approval. Waits a while for the user to approve, then reports back. Call this instead of asking for the signature again — repeating the original tool would put a second request in front of the wallet.

requestId.description: The requestId returned when the signing tool said it was awaiting approval

tools.name: send_native_token
tools.description: Send native tokens (ETH, MATIC, BNB, etc.) to an address. Simulates the transaction, then sends it to the signer you choose for approval.

amount.description: Amount in native token (e.g., "0.1" for 0.1 ETH)

data.description: Optional hex-encoded data to include with transaction

signWith.description: Where to approve this: "phone" for a paired WalletConnect wallet, "browser" for the wallet signing page. Ask the user which they want — do not assume, even when only one is connected. Call wallet_status first: it says which signers are ready, and when no signing page is open it returns walletUrl. In that case give the user that link, ask them to open it and connect a wallet, and only call this once they confirm — a signing request cannot reach a page nobody has open.

account.description: Which paired wallet to ask, by address. Only needed when wallet_status reports more than one — omit it and the most recently paired one is used.

tools.name: send_erc20_token
tools.description: Send ERC20 tokens to an address. Simulates the transfer, then sends it to the signer you choose for approval.

amount.description: Amount in token units (e.g., "100" for 100 USDC)

decimals.description: Token decimals. Read from the token when omitted; when given, must match what the token reports.

signWith.description: Where to approve this: "phone" for a paired WalletConnect wallet, "browser" for the wallet signing page. Ask the user which they want — do not assume, even when only one is connected. Call wallet_status first: it says which signers are ready, and when no signing page is open it returns walletUrl. In that case give the user that link, ask them to open it and connect a wallet, and only call this once they confirm — a signing request cannot reach a page nobody has open.

account.description: Which paired wallet to ask, by address. Only needed when wallet_status reports more than one — omit it and the most recently paired one is used.

tools.name: write_contract
tools.description: Send a transaction that calls a state-changing contract function. Simulates it first, then asks your wallet to approve. Costs gas.

functionAbi.description: Function ABI definition (e.g., "function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)")

args.description: Function arguments in order matching the ABI signature. Pass uint/int values as strings.

value.description: Optional native value to send with transaction (in ETH units, e.g., "0.1")

signWith.description: Where to approve this: "phone" for a paired WalletConnect wallet, "browser" for the wallet signing page. Ask the user which they want — do not assume, even when only one is connected. Call wallet_status first: it says which signers are ready, and when no signing page is open it returns walletUrl. In that case give the user that link, ask them to open it and connect a wallet, and only call this once they confirm — a signing request cannot reach a page nobody has open.

account.description: Which paired wallet to ask, by address. Only needed when wallet_status reports more than one — omit it and the most recently paired one is used.

tools.name: sign_message
tools.description: Sign a message with your wallet, on whichever signer you choose.

signWith.description: Where to approve this: "phone" for a paired WalletConnect wallet, "browser" for the wallet signing page. Ask the user which they want — do not assume, even when only one is connected. Call wallet_status first: it says which signers are ready, and when no signing page is open it returns walletUrl. In that case give the user that link, ask them to open it and connect a wallet, and only call this once they confirm — a signing request cannot reach a page nobody has open.

account.description: Which paired wallet to ask, by address. Only needed when wallet_status reports more than one — omit it and the most recently paired one is used.

tools.name: pair_phone_wallet
tools.description: Pair a phone wallet over WalletConnect, so transactions are signed on the phone instead of in a browser. Returns a QR to scan plus links that open a wallet directly — show those to the user as clickable links. Always pairs: call it when the user wants a wallet connected, and call wallet_status instead to find out whether one already is. Pairing again adds a wallet rather than replacing one, and signing tools then take "account" to choose between them. Requires a WalletConnect project id.

chains.description: Chains to request access to (defaults to every supported network)

wallet.description: Name of the wallet to open, e.g. "rabby" — omit to list the common ones

agent.description: Who is asking, shown in the wallet approval dialog, e.g. "Claude Code". Say who you actually are — the user reads this when deciding whether to grant signing access.

tools.name: disconnect_phone_wallet
tools.description: End WalletConnect sessions and drop the pairings underneath them. Without "account" this disconnects every paired wallet, so name one when the user only wants that wallet gone — wallet_status lists them.

account.description: Address of the one wallet to disconnect. Omit to disconnect every wallet paired here.

tools.name: wallet_status
tools.description: Report every signer and whether it is ready, so a signing tool can be given the right signWith.
